project.name: Quality Runner audit and evidence engine
project.identity: The Quality Runner engine for bounded inspection, evidence contracts, and findings.
project.audience: Developers, agents, and fleet consumers that need reproducible quality evidence.
project.core_loop: Discover the target, detect capabilities and standards, run bounded inspections, and emit evidence-backed findings.
project.north_star: A quality result is scoped, explainable, and honest about what was not observed.
not_this: Claiming consumer parity from source tests

scope.purpose: Inspect a scoped repository, normalize evidence, and produce an explainable quality audit without mutating the target.
scope.boundary: Owns audit, discovery, evidence normalization, contract and finding production in quality_runner and quality_evidence_contract; remediation execution and consumer presentation remain outside this child.
non_goals: Claiming consumer parity from source tests

mvp.definition: The scoped boundary is explicitly ratified, its parent outcome is clear, and its smallest local proof is repeatable.

complete_product.definition: The scoped boundary remains aligned through changes, interfaces, and user-visible or consumer-facing verification.

outcomes.name: The Quality Runner audit and evidence engine boundary advances its parent outcome without silently taking on sibling responsibilities.

layers.implemented: Observed implementation paths: quality_runner/audit.py, quality_runner/audit_evidence.py, quality_runner/application/read_only_audit.py, quality_evidence_contract.
layers.verified: No independently scoped end-to-end proof has been accepted yet.
